title: Degraded semantics diverge across base, resolution, and property
description: SA and QE convergent: base says degraded on unreachability; the 1b property fires on mismatch too; QE adds malformed input is unplaced. Unified semantics: degraded exactly when tracker corroboration is absent or unusable (malformed); a present-but-disagreeing tracker files the integrity finding, resolved toward the artifact, without degrading. Property, base line, and resolution all restated to the unified rule. [owner: solution-owner; validator: quality-engineer]
